strategies.name: Base Breakout v3
strategies.description: Buys clean breakouts from 4–10 week bases on heavy volume.
rules: A base of 4–10 weeks (default 6) no deeper than 20% that closes mostly in its upper half.
Today clears the base high on volume of at least the volume multiple × the 20-day average.
Relative strength rank at or above the minimum.
Buy stop 0.3% above the base high; stop 1.5× ATR(14) below entry; target at the base high plus twice the base depth.

assumptions.survivorship: Uses today's universe: results are biased upward until point-in-time data is licensed.

strategies.name: Trend Momentum
strategies.description: Rides leaders above a rising 21-day EMA with MACD confirmation.
rules: Close above a rising 21-day EMA, with the 21-day EMA above the 50-day SMA.
Relative strength rank at or above the minimum.
Exit on a close below the 21-day EMA or at the 2× ATR trailing stop.

assumptions.survivorship: Uses today's universe: results are biased upward until point-in-time data is licensed.

strategies.name: Trend Pullback
strategies.description: Buys orderly dips to the 50-day once RSI resets below 45.
rules: Uptrend: close above the 200-day SMA and the 50-day SMA rising.
Price pulls back to within 2% of the 50-day SMA while RSI(14) drops below the reset level.
Buy on the first close back above the prior day's high; stop 1.5× ATR below entry.

assumptions.survivorship: Uses today's universe: results are biased upward until point-in-time data is licensed.

strategies.name: RSI(2) Mean Reversion
strategies.description: Buys short, sharp dips in long-term uptrends when 2-day RSI drops below 10.
rules: Long-term uptrend: close above the 200-day SMA.
RSI(2) closes below the entry level.
Exit when RSI(2) closes above the exit level or after 10 sessions.

assumptions.survivorship: Uses today's universe: results are biased upward until point-in-time data is licensed.

strategies.name: Earnings Drift
strategies.description: Holds stocks that gap up on earnings with heavy volume through the post-earnings drift.
rules: Earnings gap up of at least the minimum gap on at least the volume multiple × the 20-day average.
Entry on the first session that holds above the gap-day low.
Exit after the holding period or on a close below the gap-day low.

assumptions.survivorship: Uses today's universe: results are biased upward until point-in-time data is licensed.
